notes.title: In Your Face TD is now free
notes.content:
Hey all!
 
I regret to inform you that there won’t be any new updates coming out anytime soon. The reason is that we’ve chosen to put our focus elsewhere, since working on the game is not a sustainable business and is very exhausting on top of our studies.
 
We’ve just rounded a 100 sales, and I would like to thank every one of you for supporting us. Especially the beta testers who gave valuable feedback and bug reports. Shoutout to Clonedone on Reddit, you discovered more than one game breaking bug.
 
That said, I know we’re breaking a promise here. We released the game in early access with the intention of making it better, and adding more content.
If you feel like we screwed you over and would like to refund the game, and you can’t do so through Steam, then I’ll personally reimburse you*. There’s only 100 of you so it shouldn’t make me completely broke.
 
We’ve chosen to proceed by making In Your Face TD free and taking it out of early access.
 
All the best!
Mathias
 
* If you wish to get a refund and can’t do so through Steam, send me a screenshot of this page https://help.steampowered.com/en/wizard/HelpWithGame/?appid=564330 along with your paypal account to bitbreakcontact@gmail.com

notes.title: Version 0.6
notes.content:
[b]There's a new update out![/b]

Here's a changelog:

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Replaced old skeletons with cool new robots
[*]You can dismember enemies
[*]New level, very challenging has four spawn points
[*]New Spear Tower, shoots spears in all directions
[*]The total amount text in level celebration is now less confusing because it shows you how many you gained
[*]Buffed Shotgun upgrade
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug with the way level celebration music fades in
[*]You can no longer build while "You Won" text is visible.
[*]Mineral groups no longer look exactly the same
[*]Fixed bug where selection screens were not very responsive
[*]Path line is no longer visible if the spawner is not active yet
[/list]

Here's some gameplay footage from the new update, featuring level 4:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=80NGT68QFB8]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=80NGT68QFB8[/url]
